preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 10**3 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10³) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(int(x) >= 1 for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each subsequent line contains two integers n_i and k_i (1 ≤ n_i ≤ 10⁹, 1 ≤ k_i ≤ 10¹⁸) representing the test case parameters.

preconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[0]) <= 10**9 and int(line.split()[1]) <= 10**18 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The constraints for n_i and k_i are respected: 1 ≤ n_i ≤ 10⁹ and 1 ≤ k_i ≤ 10¹⁸.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.strip().split()) == 1 or len(line.strip().split()) == 2 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'YES m' where m is an integer, or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip().split()[0] in ['YES', 'NO'] for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The first word of each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip().split()[0] == 'YES' and (len(line.strip().split()) == 1 or (len(line.strip().split()) == 2 and int(line.strip().split()[1]) >= 0))) or line.strip().split()[0] == 'NO' for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', it may be followed by an integer m (log₂ of the side length of the squares in the path), or it may be 'YES' alone (though the problem guarantees a valid m exists when possible). If 'NO', no additional value follows.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip().split()[0] == 'YES' and (int(line.strip().split()[1]) if len(line.strip().split()) == 2 else 0) <= n_i) for line, n_i in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: If 'YES m' is output, m must satisfy 0 ≤ m ≤ n_i (since the side length of the squares in the path must be a power of 2 dividing the initial side length 2ⁿᵢ).

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip().split()[0] == 'YES' and (k_i >= (2**(2*n_i) - 1) - (2**(2*(n_i - m)) - 1) and k_i <= (2**(2*n_i) - 1) - (2**(2*(n_i - m - 1)) - 1))) or line.strip().split()[0] == 'NO' for line, n_i, k_i in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]) if line.strip().split()[0] == 'YES')
postconditions.description: For a 'YES' answer, there exists an integer m (0 ≤ m ≤ n_i) such that the number of splitting operations k_i satisfies: (2^(2*n_i) - 1) - (2^(2*(n_i - m)) - 1) ≤ k_i ≤ (2^(2*n_i) - 1) - (2^(2*(n_i - m - 1)) - 1). This ensures that exactly k_i splits can be performed while maintaining a path of squares of side length 2^m from the lower-left to the upper-right corner.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip().split()[0] == 'NO' and (k_i < (2**(2*n_i) - 1) - (2**(2*(n_i - n_i)) - 1) or k_i > (2**(2*n_i) - 1) - (2**(2*(n_i - 0 - 1)) - 1))) or line.strip().split()[0] == 'YES' for line, n_i, k_i in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]) if line.strip().split()[0] == 'NO')
postconditions.description: For a 'NO' answer, k_i is either too small (less than the minimum splits needed to create a path of the smallest possible squares) or too large (more than the maximum possible splits for any valid path configuration).
